source_text: Numerus prior propter peccata cassatur. Tantum valent delicta ut ne hoc quidem prosit quod in numero quis habitus sit.
pass_a_gloss: Number prior because-of sins is-voided. So-much avail faults that not this even may-profit that in number anyone held be.
pass_b_english: The former census is voided by sin. Faults so prevail that it does not even help to have been counted among the number.
